accessibility.evidence: Named image links and dialog controls. ArrowRight advances original collection; closing returns focus and scroll to the curated opener. Full-story button works; manual strip controls have labels. Reduced-motion avoids smooth scrolling.

responsive.evidence: Desktop matching landscape pair renders 530 by 353.56 pixels each with aligned edges; 390px mobile landscapes stack within 20px side margins. Neither viewport overflows.

loading.evidence: Viewer reports Loading photograph on opening before image load.

empty.reason: All eight fixed albums have 10 to 64 existing photographs; no dynamic empty collection.

partial.evidence: Curated selections and lazy thumbnail strip preserve all 305 original image links; full-resolution assets load only when opened.

error.evidence: Dispatched image error shows recovery text and original-image link; advancing chooses the next photograph.

success.evidence: Aditi viewer advances 1 to 2 of 64; Nigel advances 1 to 2 of 43. All nine album URLs, including legacy wedding URL, preserve image counts; no missing local assets or links.

permission.reason: Public static images require no account or permission.

renderedEvidence.observation: Consistent two-column landscape rows with even gutters and aligned top/bottom edges.
Landscapes stack in one column with consistent width and margins.
